mapper.select: select a.device_id, a.custom_id, a.device_code, a.device_name, a.alias_name, a.device_type, a.position_type, a.model_id, a.region_path, a.up_region_id, a.up_region_name, a.custom_name, a.custom_type, a.status, a.update_time, a.create_time from t_std_device a where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} limit 1

select a.device_id , a.custom_id , a.device_code , a.device_name , a.alias_name , a.device_type , h.dict_note as deviceTypeName, a.position_type , a.model_id , a.region_path , a.up_region_id , a.up_region_name , a.custom_name , a.custom_type , a.status , a.update_time , a.create_time , b.device_model, e.dict_note as deviceModelName, b.pms_type, b.pms_id, b.device_vendor, f.dict_note deviceVendorName, b.production_date , b.used_time, b.disable_date, b.last_maintenance, b.maintenance_count, b.organization, b.department, b.responsible_person, b.latitude, b.longitude, b.ip, b.port, b.voltage_Level, g.dict_note as voltageLevelName, b.sequence_point , b.real_code , b.address, d.model_name as modelName from t_std_device a,t_std_device_attr b,t_std_metemodel d,t_dict_business e,t_dict_business f,t_dict_business g,t_dict_business h where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = b.device_id and d.model_id=a.model_id and b.device_model = e.dict_code and b.device_vendor=f.dict_code and b.voltage_level=g.dict_code and h.dict_code = a.device_type and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

select DISTINCT a.device_id, b.region_id, b.region_name, b.sort, b.up_region_id, b.up_region_ids, b.region_code, b.station_id, b.state, b.create_time from t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id where 1 = 1 and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT c.custom_id AS Id, c.custom_name AS label, c.device_id AS upId, e.device_name AS upName, "custom" AS infoType FROM t_std_device c LEFT JOIN t_std_device e ON c.device_id = e.device_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.robot_id AS Id, b.robot_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "robot" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT c.robot_id AS Id, c.robot_name AS label, c.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "robot" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info c LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON c.up_region_id = d.region_id) union all ( select e.inspection_id as Id, e.inspection_name as label, f.robot_id as upId, f.robot_name as upName, "inspection" as infoType from t_robot_inspection e left join t_robot_info f on f.robot_id = e.robot_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.device_id AS Id, b.device_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "device" AS infoType FROM t_std_device b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT DISTINCT b.robot_id AS Id, b.robot_name AS label, b.up_region_id AS upId, d.region_name AS upName, "robot" AS infoType FROM t_robot_info b LEFT JOIN t_std_region d ON b.up_region_id = d.region_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT e.inspection_id AS Id, e.inspection_name AS label, f.robot_id AS upId, f.robot_name AS upName, "inspection" AS infoType FROM t_robot_inspection e LEFT JOIN t_robot_info f ON f.robot_id = e.robot_id) UNION ALL ( SELECT e.preset_id AS Id, e.preset_name AS label, f.camera_id AS upId, f.camera_name AS upName, "preset" AS infoType FROM t_camera_preset e LEFT JOIN t_camera_info f ON f.camera_id = e.camera_id);
